title: Stability and Similarity

body.text: (consistency — low = more emotional variety, high = steady and even) and
(how close to the reference voice). For ads that need emotion, lower Stability; for long readings that need steadiness, raise Stability.

example: Documentary narration → high Stability for a steady tone; fun ad → low Stability for emotion

title: Experiment and compare

body.text: generate several versions with different settings and compare
, then keep the one that fits best. Adjusting one value at a time and listening helps you understand what each does.

example: Read the same sentence 3 times at Stability 30 / 50 / 70, then pick the most natural one
